title: Balanced constant tensor section presheaf morphism
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X → Spec(k), g:Y → Spec(k), and F and G sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. There exists an O_Y-linear presheaf morphism from picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g Gamma(X,F) G [lem-sc-picard-constant-sections-tensor-basis] to the underlying presheaf of pr2_*(externalCupCoefficients f g F G) [pqf-def-cohomology]. At every open V of Y, its component is bijective if and only if externalSectionsComponent f g F G V [lem-sc-external-sections-components] is bijective. There are no quasi-coherence, compactness, or affine-diagonal assumptions. All objects lie in the same universe.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, affine-open degree-zero calculation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED

proof.text: At V identify the scalar-extension tensor coefficient value with Gamma(X,F) tensor_k G(V): (a tensor s) tensor t maps to s tensor (a*t), and the inverse sends s tensor t to (1 tensor s) tensor t. Balance and tensor induction prove inverse identities. Compose with the explicit external section component. Its second projection unit and multiplication on tensor sections prove O_Y(V)-linearity. Restriction compatibility of the balanced maps and externalSectionsComponent_naturality assemble a presheaf morphism. The scalar actions on its target agree by the pullback square. Composition with the balanced bijection gives exactly the asserted equivalence of bijectivity. The same formulas hold on empty opens and zero modules.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_external_constant_sections_tensor_map
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) :
    ∃ φ : picardConstantSectionsTensor k Y g (scalarObj f F (op ⊤)) G ⟶
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.snd f g).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).val,
      ∀ V : Y.Opens, Function.Bijective (φ.app (op V)) ↔
        Function.Bijective (externalSectionsComponent f g F G V)
